item.title: Sparse routing keeps accuracy at 40% of the compute
item.description: The paper reports a router that activates 40% of expert capacity during decoding while retaining 98.6% of dense-model accuracy on six reasoning benchmarks.

item.title: Long-context retrieval still fails at 200K on real documents
item.description: Evaluations on real 200K-token documents show retrieval-augmented pipelines losing 22 points versus synthetic needles, with mid-context positions the weakest.
